reading.body:
This campus in Medford, Oregon has no published power capacity, and research to locate a figure has been exhausted. The operator describes itself as the largest independent colocation provider in Southern Oregon and Northern California, with markets in Medford, Ashland, Klamath Falls, and Grants Pass, and states it has operated since 2004. Without published megawatts, this facility cannot be ranked against peers or placed in Oregon's AI infrastructure.

Oregon has 133 mapped data center facilities and only 8 with published capacity figures totaling 156.6 MW. This campus would rank ninth in the state if it had published capacity, placing it outside the published tier. The state context alone does not establish whether the facility is regional colocation infrastructure or meaningfully scaled for AI training.

The location is confirmed in Medford. The research budget for this entry has been fully spent and returned no megawatt figure. To assess whether this campus matters to AI infrastructure, the operator's published specification page would need to state a capacity, or on-site verification would be required.
